audit: Independent offline Codex gateway and deployment credential boundary audit

scope.external_requests: Only public npm package installation and previously fetched public official source were used. Gateway/auth exchanges use MockTransport; downstream HTTP uses loopback.
scope.runtime_claim: Real aiohttp listeners, real RuntimeSupervisor reload sequence, actual pinned pi client, synthetic upstream provider. This is not a live ChatGPT/OpenMA/KVM production integration certification.

current_requirements.requirement: OpenMA custom ModelCard with pi_config.api=openai-responses, gpt-6.1-sol, base_url=http://tank:8790/v1; internal key only; Tank signs with operator Codex OAuth.
Single Python process gateway, startup/reload/ordered closing endpoint; exactly tank/openma/postgres Compose services, no published host ports.
Writable codex-auth only in Tank; no OAuth in OpenMA or sandboxes; Docker secret files outside repository; provider usage-limit/reset passthrough, no invented local spending/token caps.

confirmed: JSON refresh grant at fixed OAuth URL with public CLI clientID and refresh_reason
Codex ChatGPT auth schema; optional rotated token preservation
streaming Responses endpoint and Codex primary/secondary reset headers
ModelCard wireModel/apiKey/baseURL/provider/piConfig are resolved by pinned OpenMA

pi_ai.actual_flow: pi stream(openai-responses,provider=tank-codex,fake internal key) -> real localhost gateway -> MockTransport fixed CodexURL/fake OAuth -> synthetic terminal SSE -> actual pi parser start/done
verified_request_fields: developer initial instruction promoted to instructions
prompt_cache_retention24h emitted by generic pi client and removed by gateway
internal Bearer replaced by fake OAuth; fake accountID added
toolCall/function_call and toolResult/function_call_output IDs paired through gateway
pi_ai.reproduction: npm install --prefix /tmp/tank-gateway-pi-audit --ignore-scripts --omit=optional --no-audit --no-fund @earendil-works/pi-ai@1.1.0; then run pytest tests/test_gateway_audit.py. Override package location with TANK_AUDIT_PI_PACKAGE. Test skips explicitly when external dependency or Node is unavailable.

audit_regressions: Unauthorized HTTP request with unfinished999999byte body receives401 before body/auth-file/provider access
Concurrent initial401 wave and delayed stale401 replies refresh only once
Cancelling refresh caller still persists provider-rotated refresh token before gateway close
Malformed/string/bool/expired/NaN/infinite refresh expiry cannot overwrite existing auth
OAuth redirect never followed; no Location/cookie leakage
HTTPS_PROXY environment ignored; incoming cookies/proxy-auth and provider cookie jar excluded
Provider429 Retry-After and reset-at preserved; no local retry/reset invented
Malformed scalar/string/invalidJSON/invalidUTF8 nonstreamSSE fails with static errors and credential-free diagnostics
Actual RuntimeSupervisor rejected candidate keeps live listener; accepted candidate rebinds same port and key changes; shutdown closes port
Actual pinned pi1.1.0 request and terminalSSE parser roundtrip through real gateway
NonUTF8/invalid Authorization returns401 before unfinished body/auth-file/provider access
Nonstream upstream.close exception cannot log synthetic OAuth; diagnostic is static
Whole HTTP client.close failure becomes static error; second close is idempotent
Actual pinned pi replay includes encrypted reasoning, function call and matching function-call-output

findings.issue: Request cancellation during rotating token exchange discarded new tokens
findings.fix: Shielded tracked credential tasks persist provider rotation even after caller cancellation; close drains tasks; bounded total refresh timeout.

findings.issue: Malformed refresh JWT expiry could overwrite auth before post-write validation
findings.fix: Validate refreshed access/expiry before persistence; preserve old auth on malformed values.

findings.issue: Unexpected malformed SSE exceptions could enter aiohttp diagnostics
findings.fix: Static exception boundary prevents credential-bearing exception rendering.

findings.issue: Connection-nominated allowlisted response headers were forwarded
findings.fix: Exclude dynamic Connection tokens from allowlist response forwarding.

findings.issue: Nonstream early terminal return followed by failing upstream.aclose bypassed static handler and logged synthetic OAuth plaintext
findings.fix: All upstream response closure uses a static diagnostic boundary; nonstream completion/401/OAuth cleanup do not print transport exceptions. Whole-client shutdown errors become static GatewayError with suppressed exception chaining.

findings.issue: NonUTF8 Authorization header failed UTF8 reencoding before authentication handling, producing500/default aiohttp log instead of401
findings.fix: Compare the one raw Authorization header value as bytes; reject malformed/duplicate headers before reading body or OAuth.

findings.issue: Unrelated tokenmetadata edits during refresh could be misclassified as credential replacement and discard provider-rotated tokens
findings.fix: Fingerprint actual credential fields only; merge unrelated external metadata when persisting. Owner regression included in passing combined suite.

limitations: No real subscription model entitlement or real refresh tested; tokens deliberately not requested/read.
No Linux/KVM microVM runtime certification; deployment owner verifies available image/Compose steps separately.

Abrupt process or host power loss after provider rotation but before receiving/persisting response is an unavoidable external token handoff window; atomic file fsync/replace protects file integrity, not provider-side distributed transaction.

One active gateway writer is required; no distributed cross-container/external-writer lock. Operator replacement before persist is observed, but arbitrary external writes at the exact replacement instant cannot be made transactional.
No production latency/throughput/backpressure stress claim; semantic streaming/cancellation/backpressure verified by local tests.
Any full service startup requiring operator business configuration or real external service credentials remains separate from this offline gateway audit.
